title: CC: Tweaked More Tool Variants Compat
description: Allows Computercraft turtles to hold More Tool Variants' tools.
body: This datapack packaged as a mod adds compatibility between [CC: Tweaked](https://modrinth.com/mod/cc-tweaked) and [More Tool Variants (MStV+)](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-tool-variants) by allowing turtles to hold every diamond tool variant.
